technical_and_design_decisions: Combined duplicate user stories U3 and U4 into a single development effort for Redis-based field-value counter aggregation.
Upgraded Reactor dependency across all sub-projects in Gradle/Maven build configuration to 2.0 RC1 and updated affected API calls.
Created a dedicated sub-project for Hadoop integration tests to decouple dependencies from DIRT and fix Eclipse classpath generation.
Exposed configuration properties for HttpChunkAggregator mapped to servers.yml to override default 1MB message size limit.
assumptions: Access to an AWS EC2 test environment with YARN installed is available for developing and executing automated acceptance tests (U6).
Requirements U3 and U4 are identical duplicate requirements in the input specification.
The developer performs all implementation, build configuration, unit/integration testing, and documentation updates personally.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement the Reactor-based stream processor plugin allowing specification of processor class with minimal configuration and supporting module option commands.
Update build configurations to Reactor 2.0 RC1 and refactor codebase to handle API breaking changes or deprecations.

activities.activity_name: Implement Redis Aggregation for Field-Value Counters (U3 & U4)
activities.activity_description: Port aggregate field-value counter specs from Spring XD, implement continuous Redis writing, identify gaps, and update reference documentation.

activities.activity_name: Isolate Hadoop Tests into Separate Sub-Project (U5)
activities.activity_description: Move Hadoop integration tests to an isolated module to eliminate DIRT project dependency issues and fix Eclipse classpath generation.

activities.activity_name: Create XD + YARN Acceptance Test Suite on EC2 (U6)
activities.activity_description: Develop automated acceptance tests and EC2 execution scripts to verify XD functionality running on YARN during build cycles.
Create RxJava-based processor module enabling developers to use RxJava APIs for streaming data computations.

activities.activity_name: Expose Configurable Message Size for HTTP Source (U8)
activities.activity_description: Extend HTTP source module configuration to allow overriding HttpChunkAggregator 1MB limit via servers.yml.

activities.activity_name: End-to-End Integration Testing and Documentation Build
activities.activity_description: Perform full integration testing across all updated components, verify build artifacts, and generate final documentation.
